name: ai_file_name
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: builds AI<course id>.AI into the static buffer at 0x664320 and returns it (no loading here)

name: ai_load
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: opens ai.piz, reads chunk 0x13269902 (0x11884 bytes, struct AiData) into g_ai_data

name: ai_save
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: writes chunk 0x13269902 with the 0x11884 byte g_ai_data to AI<course id>.AI (editor feature)

name: ai_clear
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: fills the grid and the tile pool with -1 and resets the counters (editor: clear data)

name: ai_editor
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: the built-in AI editor: reset car, start / stop race, single step, route editing (uses grid_position and car_spawn)

name: ai_editor_menu_draw
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: draws the editor menu: race lines, inside lines, slow lines, cheat lines, danger data, save data, clear data

name: ai_paint_cell
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: (x, z, value): paints a danger data cell (8 world units per cell), allocating a tile from the pool when needed

name: ai_erase_cell
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: (x, z): clears a cell and frees the tile when it became empty

name: ai_cell_is_value2
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: danger data cell value == 2 at a world position

name: ai_bot_update
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: (player): clears the player's input bytes, then picks the route set / slot (falling back to race line slot 0 when it has fewer than 4 points) and drives (ai_drive_*)

name: ai_drive_a
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: bot steering: target point from ai_find_target_a/b/c with speed and forward vector (variant a)

name: ai_drive_b
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: bot steering variant b (same call pattern as ai_drive_a)

name: ai_drive_c
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: bot steering variant c (same call pattern as ai_drive_a)

name: ai_find_target_a
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: inferred: candidate target point for a bot (first choice in the ai_drive_* variants)

name: ai_find_target_b
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: inferred: second choice of target point

name: ai_find_target_c
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: inferred: third choice of target point

name: ai_target_check
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: inferred: validates a candidate target (position, target)

name: ai_nearest_route_point
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: nearest point of a route (points at +0x0, count at +0x200) to a position, with a per player hint

name: led_file_name
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: builds toastart/common/led/LE<n>.LED into the static buffer at 0x652CC0 (no loading here; LE = line exceptions, chunk 0x13269901)

name: @g_ai_data
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: struct AiData (0x11884 bytes) loaded from AI<course>.AI

name: @g_ai_file_name
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: static buffer returned by ai_file_name

name: @g_led_file_name
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: static buffer written by led_file_name

name: @g_line_exceptions
comment (MFL.exe AI: file I/O: 0x480 dwords loaded from LE1.LED (-1.0 = unused)
